title: Backups and jobs
subtitle: Back up, inject again or reset the devices of a bench

notice.locked: Bench locked ({reason}): only admins run jobs on it.
notice.offer: Your team has just released {bench}: you can still back up its configurations.
notice.otherTeam: Team {team} holds this bench: you see your backups, but only its occupants run jobs.
notice.takeFirst: Take the bench for your team (Consoles) before you run a job.
notice.base: Base configuration applied after a reset: {name}.

passwords.title: Device passwords (if needed)
passwords.hint: Used during this job only: never stored nor logged.

backup.title: Back up {bench}
backup.intro: The running-config of each ticked device is read (and the VLANs on switches), then kept in a backup of your team.
backup.label: Name of the backup

reset.title: Reset {bench}
reset.intro: Each ticked device goes back to its factory configuration. In this order, for each of them:

erased.backup: its configuration is backed up first, then read back from the disk to check the backup;
erased.vlan: on a switch, flash:vlan.dat is deleted: every VLAN goes;
erased.register: on a router, the configuration register is set back to 0x2102;
erased.reload: it reloads without saving: the running-config is lost;
erased.refuse: if its backup fails, it is not erased.

reset.force: erase even if the backup fails

countdown.one: The job starts {count} second later: you (and whoever follows it) can still stop it.
countdown.other: The job starts {count} seconds later: you (and whoever follows it) can still stop it.

inject.title: Inject on {bench}
inject.intro: Choose a backup or a lab template: you will see the exact script each device receives before anything starts.
inject.previewReset: Each device is backed up, erased and reloaded, then receives this script from "{source}". It is then read back and compared.
inject.previewMerge: Each device is backed up, then receives this script from "{source}" without being erased.

dropped.one: {count} line that cannot be replayed removed
dropped.other: {count} lines that cannot be replayed removed

dropped.licence: licence tied to the chassis, not replayable
dropped.certificate: certificate generated by the device itself
dropped.banner: the banner uses every possible delimiter

compare.title: Compare {bench} with a backup
compare.intro: The current running-config of each device is read (nothing is changed) and compared with the backup.

download.title: Download this backup now.
download.body: The server is not a backup: it may be wiped between two sessions. Keep the ZIP yourself.

snapshots.title: Team backups
snapshots.notBackup: The server is not a backup: download your ZIPs and keep them.
snapshots.deleteBody: The backup of {date} is deleted from the server. Without its ZIP, it is lost.

templates.title: Lab templates
templates.newIntro: A configuration sent to every device (for example the base configuration applied after a reset).
templates.fromSnapshotIntro: The configurations of this backup ({devices}) become a template anyone may inject on their bench.
templates.name: Name
templates.configPlaceholder:
no ip domain-lookup
line con 0
 logging synchronous
templates.base: This is the base configuration applied after a reset
templates.deleteBody: Nobody will be able to inject it any more.

diff.title: Differences with "{a}"
diff.none: No other backup to compare with.

report.title: {kind} of {bench}

check.same: read back: identical to the source
check.changed: read back: differences with the source (+{added} / −{removed})

warning.erased_without_backup: erased without a backup (ticked by an admin)
warning.base_missing: base configuration not applied: its template is gone
warning.base_damaged: base configuration not applied: its file is damaged
warning.base_not_saved: base configuration not saved: the device refused lines

report.startupKept: startup-config backed up too (it was not the running-config)
report.notSaved: not saved: the startup-config was left as it was
report.redacted: The configuration lines of this report are for the team that held the bench and for admins.

errors.not_occupant: Only the occupants of this bench (and admins) run jobs on it.
errors.bench_busy: Another job is already running on this bench ({name}).
errors.unknown_device: One of these devices is not on this bench.
errors.bad_passwords: Three passwords at most, 64 characters at most.
errors.confirm_bench: Type the name of the bench ({bench}) to confirm.
errors.force_admin_only: Only an admin may erase a device whose backup failed.
errors.no_source: Choose a backup or a template to inject.
errors.bad_mode: The mode is "reset, then inject" or "merge".
errors.preview_stale: What would be sent is no longer what you saw ({devices}): look at the preview again.
errors.snapshot_forbidden: This backup belongs to another team.
errors.no_device: This device is not in the backup.
errors.cancel_forbidden: Only the person who started it, the occupants of the bench and admins may stop it.
errors.other_bench: This backup is of another bench.
errors.no_team: You need a team to keep backups.
errors.zip_invalid: This file is not a readable ZIP archive.
errors.zip_unsafe: The archive holds a file whose name leaves its folder ({name}): nothing was imported.
errors.zip_too_large: The archive is too large once unpacked (more than {max} MB): nothing was imported.
errors.zip_empty: No configuration of this bench's devices in the archive.
errors.bad_template: A template needs a name (80 characters at most) and at least one configuration.
errors.config_too_large: The configuration of {device} is too large.
errors.config_binary: The configuration of {device} is not text.
errors.config_not_a_config: The file of {device} does not look like a configuration.
errors.backup_failed: The backup failed, the device was not erased: {cause}
errors.backup_not_written: The backup could not be written on the server.
errors.backup_unverified: The backup written does not read back as it was taken.
errors.not_allowed: The bench is no longer yours (locked, or taken by another team): device not processed.
errors.interrupted: The server restarted during the job: check the device on its console.
errors.device_failed: The device could not be processed.
errors.shared_in_use: {device} shares its console line with {bench}, held by another team: it is left alone.
errors.script_errors: The device refused {count} line(s): nothing was saved. Read the refused lines, then save by hand if you wish.
errors.check_differs: The device does not read back as the source (+{added} / −{removed}): nothing was saved.
errors.startup_unread: The startup configuration could not be read.

audit.compare: {who} compared the bench with a backup ({device})
